metadata.question: Were there more snow in north-central Chile in July, 16 2022 than July 7, 2022?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: North-central Chile (approximately -30°S, -70°W, covering areas like Coquimbo region) - Dates: July 16, 2022 vs July 7, 2022 (two specific dates) - Collection: Sentinel-2 for snow detection (NDSI - Normalized Difference Snow Index) or MODIS snow products - Will use Sentinel-2 L2A with NDSI calculation (Green - SWIR) / (Green + SWIR) 2. Masking strategy: - Need to mask clouds since we're detecting snow (clouds can be confused with snow) - Use QA60 band for cloud masking in Sentinel-2 - NDSI > 0.4 typically indicates snow 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero (B): Snow count is legitimately 0 or lower on July 16 than July 7 - A: More snow on July 16 than July 7 - C1: No images found for either date - C2: After cloud masking, no valid pixels remain - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN or invalid values ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define north-central Chile region (Coquimbo area) const region = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-71.5, -31.5, -69.5, -29.5]); // Cloud masking function for Sentinel-2 function maskClouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // Function to calculate NDSI and count snow pixels function calculateSnow(image) { const ndsi = image.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B11']).rename('NDSI'); const snow = ndsi.gt(0.4); return snow; } // Get images for July 7, 2022 const col1 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate('2022-07-07', '2022-07-08') .map(maskClouds); const size1 = await col1.size().getInfo(); // Get images for July 16, 2022 const col2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate('2022-07-16', '2022-07-17') .map(maskClouds); const size2 = await col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`July 7 images: ${size1}`); console.log(`July 16 images: ${size2}`); if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log('Missing data for one or both dates'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Process July 7 data const img1 = col1.median(); const snow1 = calculateSnow(img1); const stats1 = await snow1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const snowCount1 = stats1.NDSI_sum || 0; const pixelCount1 = stats1.NDSI_count || 0; // Process July 16 data const img2 = col2.median(); const snow2 = calculateSnow(img2); const stats2 = await snow2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const snowCount2 = stats2.NDSI_sum || 0; const pixelCount2 = stats2.NDSI_count || 0; console.log(`July 7: Snow pixels=${snowCount1}, Valid pixels=${pixelCount1}`); console.log(`July 16: Snow pixels=${snowCount2}, Valid pixels=${pixelCount2}`); if (pixelCount1 === 0 || pixelCount2 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after cloud masking'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (snowCount1 === null || snowCount2 === null || isNaN(snowCount1) || isNaN(snowCount2)) { console.log('Invalid calculation results'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (snowCount2 > snowCount1) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
